acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of dry rot repair varies greatly depending on the extent of the damage, the location within your home, and the type of wood or structural components needing replacement. Minor surface dry rot might be less costly, while extensive structural repairs involving load-bearing elements will be more significant. For homes in Garden City and surrounding areas, we provide a detailed, itemized estimate after a comprehensive on-site assessment, ensuring transparency and accuracy tailored to your specific situation.
